description: This file defines functions and configuration for setting up and managing an IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel (6in4) in OpenWrt. It includes functions for testing IP ranges, updating tunnel status, and configuring tunnel parameters, as well as protocol initialization and teardown.

methods.name: test_6in4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within private or special ranges (RFC 1918, RFC 6598).

methods.name: proto_6in4_update
methods.description: Executes a command with a timeout, used for updating tunnel status.

methods.name: proto_6in4_add_prefix
methods.description: Adds an IPv6 prefix to the configuration.

methods.name: proto_6in4_setup
methods.description: Configures and initializes the IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel with provided parameters.

methods.name: proto_6in4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration options for the protocol.
